import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialSheaf
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4AffineDifferentialFrame

/-!
# Local extension of regular rational differentials

A rational differential in the regular lattice at a point is regular on a
neighborhood of that point. The extension uses a common affine differential
frame and the stalk property of the structure sheaf. Only integrality and
smoothness are needed.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A differential regular at one point extends as a regular rational
differential on a neighborhood of that point. -/
theorem exists_regularDifferentialSections_of_mem_lattice (x : X.left)
    (η : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hη : η ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
    ∃ U : X.left.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ η ∈ regularDifferentialSections X U := by
  obtain ⟨V, -, hxV, -, ω, -, hframes⟩ :=
    smoothCurve_exists_affine_differentialFrame_at X x
  obtain ⟨ex, hex⟩ := hframes x hxV
  let a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x := ex.symm ⟨η, hη⟩
  have hηeq : (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField a) • ω = η := by
    rw [← hex, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
    change ((a • ex 1 : curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x) :
      CurveRationalDifferentials X) = η
    rw [← ex.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (ex.apply_symm_apply ⟨η, hη⟩)
  obtain ⟨U, hUV, hxU, s, hs⟩ := X.left.presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq a hxV
  have hgeneric : genericPoint X.left ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X.left).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (show (U : Set X.left).Nonempty from ⟨x, hxU⟩))
  have hsx : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField a =
      (X.left.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X.left) hgeneric).hom s := by
    rw [← hs]
    exact X.left.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hxU
      ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial) s
  refine ⟨U, hxU, (mem_regularDifferentialSections_of_nonempty X ⟨x, hxU⟩).mpr ?_⟩
  intro y _ hyU
  obtain ⟨ey, hey⟩ := hframes y (hUV hyU)
  let b : X.left.presheaf.stalk y := (X.left.presheaf.germ U y hyU).hom s
  have hsy : algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk y) X.left.functionField b =
      (X.left.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X.left) hgeneric).hom s :=
    X.left.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hyU
      ((genericPoint_spec X.left).specializes trivial) s
  rw [← hηeq, hsx, ← hsy, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
  exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X y).smul_mem b (hey ▸ (ey 1).property)

end
end Hartshorne
